description: Review a Terraform module for public ACLs, literal credentials, wildcard IAM policies, disabled encryption, publicly accessible resources and security-group ingress open to 0.0.0.0/0, each with the line number. As a fast first pass over a module before a full plan or a policy scan. Do not choose this when you need evaluated plan output or a policy engine such as OPA. Example requests: Review this Terraform module for security problems. | Does this .tf file hardcode any credentials or open a bucket publicly? | Audit my infrastructure-as-code module before I apply it.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

module.description: The customer's module.tf, as text. Supported: HCL (.tf) text. The Terraform module source. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
